purpose: Operationalize the frozen protocol using the existing severe-gate/gate-trajectory reporting definitions before new test inference.
primary_comparison: reserved capped_robust versus robust_bounded, all six assignments and three attack modes; validation and test reported separately without choosing the favorable split
worst_trigger_asr: maximum of complete-trigger and three component-trigger ASR at one round; non-target-label denominator
paired_peak_harm: maximum over paired fixed rounds 1..15 of attacked worst-trigger ASR minus the same method's own clean worst-trigger ASR at that round; negative values are retained
effective_raw_control: at some paired round, raw TPM-only worst-trigger ASR increase >=0.20 and clean-control macro-F1 minus attacked macro-F1 <=0.05; inherited historical reporting rule, evaluated on the same split
clean_utility: all nine known/reserved clean assignments, alternatives versus raw TPM-only macro-F1 at rounds 10 and 15, validation and test separately; loss <=0.02
security_guard: all 18 reserved capped_robust/robust_bounded comparisons defined, capped_robust no greater paired peak harm in every comparison, and strict benefit in at least two effective raw-control cases including non-IID; also report capped_sample and every ineffective control
continuity: all clean histories complete 15 rounds; retained nominal admission mass >=4/5; capped methods normalized nonnegative beta, at least ten positive coefficients and top-three final share <=1/3; distinguish alpha and beta
failures: every planned case and genuine terminal failure is reported; missing endpoints/undefined comparisons are null, never zero ASR
residuals: fixed-round 10 and 15 parameter L2 and untriggered prediction differences against the same method's own clean history; differences do not alone establish harmful residual poisoning or restoration
timing: raw FedAvg aggregation_seconds is its repeated actual computation; special methods use final_operator_seconds for the first uncached operator computation. Preserve raw fields. Inclusive/nested search, geometry and operator timings are not summed as disjoint costs. Shared host with two concurrent workers; historical retained timings disclosed.
qualification: Finite exploratory assignments on previously observed Data24; no automatic default change, malicious-client classification guarantee, fresh TPM quote, physical TPM result, independent dataset or universal ASR guarantee.
